# Engine E2E's 15 shards are planned at 99% of the step ceiling

## Context

Since #22101 refreshed the duration table, 3 of 4 full `dev` Engine runs went red: [`39d60b64a7`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/45203848705), [`f8635546e0`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/45231045099), [`f80d68a3d4`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/45235232106). Five of the six red shards hit the six-minute step ceiling; the sixth is #22114. The outside contributor's #22087 is red the same way. On 2026-11-23 the operator asked for a v14 without flaky CI, and #21033's AC-3 needs a green Engine run on the cut candidate.

## The Problem

The table holds 325 specs and 5,341 s. Fifteen shards at 360 s give 5,400 s, so `balancedShard()` fills every shard to 356–357 s. Measured run-step times on those runs spread from 239 s to past 373 s, so most full runs push at least one shard over. A refresh redistributes the total but cannot add slack the total no longer leaves; three refreshes ran today (#22073, #22077, #22101).

## The Architectural Reality

- A full selection only reports its reasons, so a full run takes `test.yml`'s matrix defaults (`[1..15]` and `[15]`, L497–498). `FULL_SHARDS.engine` (`buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs:219`) sizes partial selections proportionally and caps them. The unit spec "the engine workflow's full matrix is FULL_SHARDS" keeps the two equal.
- Design authority: `test.yml`'s capacity note gives a shard nearing the ceiling a sibling when the runner budget has room. D#21957's trial (#22026) ran 18 shards green in both pairs, at about 8 more runner-minutes per run. The cut steward withdrew #22026's retain-15 on this evidence at 18:24Z. On the org's Team plan, jobs start 1–3 s after creation (run 45235232106 and both #22026 pairs).

## The Fix

Set `FULL_SHARDS.engine` from 15 to 18 and change the two `test.yml` defaults with it, for a planned load of about 297 s per shard. Update the prose that names the count (`learn/guides/testing/WhiteboxE2E.md`, `classify-test-scope.yml`). The release notes' line is left to the notes refresh (#22091).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Every current Engine spec is assigned exactly once across 18 shards, and the PR reports the planned maximum. (#22116: 327 specs, 0 duplicates, 0 missing; 264–301 s planned.)
- [x] `E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs` passes, including the workflow-matrix guard. (40/40 locally; green in #22116's CI.)
- [x] The PR's full Engine matrix runs on 18 shards, and its aggregate passes. (#22116 at `2dd3117f17`: 18/18 green.)
- [x] Post-merge: the next full `dev` Engine run on 18 shards. [Run 45246636062](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/45246636062) at `20bb2e02d8`: no step timeouts (222–308 s). Attempt 1 had one first-sighting flake (`RowPinning.spec.mjs:37`, shard 1/18), and attempt 2 passed. Recorded here, because #21033 is at its comment cap.

## Out of Scope

The six-minute ceiling; splitting slow specs (`ExamplesCatalogNL` at 237 s is the largest); the Docs index generated on two shards, which #22026 measured at 18; the Workstation flake (#22114).
